definitions.explanation: A question word asking about time. Used to inquire when something happens, happened, or will happen.

examples.japanese: いつ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: When did you come to Japan?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いつ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
いつでも⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いつ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧いつ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: When does summer vacation start and end?
examples.notes: いつから = from when, いつまで = until when

examples.japanese: いつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っています→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、いつ⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}かりません→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan someday, but I don't know when I'll be able to go.

notes:
いつ is one of the essential question words (5W1H) used to ask about time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いつ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from when, since when
- いつ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until when
- いつ〜ても: whenever

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always
- いつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: someday, sometime
- いつでも: anytime
- いつ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: forever, indefinitely

USAGE:
Unlike ⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧ (what time), いつ asks about dates or general timing rather than specific clock time.
